title: Daily Chief Inspector Report
contractor: West Tech Energy — Jose Salaises, Director of Operations

sections.heading: Summary of the Day
paragraphs: Today was a half day ahead of the Thanksgiving break. We received the flare anchor details for the updated anchoring drawing. The flare will use two 7/8" F1554 Grade 36 anchor bolts per leg (six total) with heavy hex nuts and washers, 1'-9" long, with 15" embedment and 4" projection, plus one shear hairpin per leg. The existing flare base plate holes are 3/4", so the field will need to drill them out to 15/16" for the larger bolts.

The updated detail drawing is still coming. Before we set anchors I want the drawing to confirm the bolt length (1'-9" against 15" embedment plus 4" projection), who furnishes the anchors and hairpins, and Encore's acceptance of drilling their base plates. The fuel gas spools remain on hold pending Tegre's revised isometrics. The crew is off Thursday through Sunday.
